# Aurora sandbox smoke fixtures

Minimal, redistributable inputs for the containerized fake end-to-end smoke
(server/internal/aurorafleet/docker_integration_test.go,
TestDockerSandboxFakeAuroraPipelines). Every fixture is deterministic and
contains no person, voice identity, customer data, or third-party/proprietary
content.

**License:** CC0-1.0 (public-domain dedication). The files are generated by and
released with this repository and carry no third-party copyright.

## Provenance

The PNG, WAV, and Markdown fixtures are emitted by a small Node program in the
implementation commit: PNG is a 64x64 RGB gradient written as IHDR/IDAT/IEND with
zlib level 9 and CRC32; WAV is a 44-byte RIFF header plus 4000 samples of a
220 Hz 16-bit sine at 8 kHz; the Markdown is a fixed literal. The MP4 is produced
by FFmpeg with `-fflags +bitexact -flags +bitexact -map_metadata -1`, which makes
the output byte-for-byte reproducible (verified by regenerating and comparing the
SHA-256).

```bash
ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y \
  -fflags +bitexact -flags +bitexact \
  -f lavfi -i testsrc=size=320x240:rate=10:duration=1 \
  -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=44100:duration=1 \
  -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v baseline -level 3.0 \
  -c:a aac -b:a 64k -shortest -map_metadata -1 -movflags +faststart \
  input/video/short.mp4
```

## Harness

`smoke/aurora-fake-pipelines.mjs` is mounted read-only into the real sandbox
image and executed by `/usr/local/bin/node`. It starts loopback fake Multica
control/storage/moderation, Ark, OpenAI, and Volcengine ASR endpoints, injects
them through the broker transport seam, and runs the `xhs-image`, `text-video`,
`video-captions`, and `resume` pipelines plus a provider-failure case. It performs
no external network call.
